description: The chain-derived draw tape: contract-paid draws indexed from MtokDripLedger events on Base. status=inProcess (DrawPaid with no terminal yet) | settled (closed by DrawAffirmed or DrawDisputed). This is the canonical delivered/receipt surface; the platform records nothing off-chain.

limit.description: Max draws returned, newest first, 1..200. Default 50.

status.description: "inProcess" = DrawPaid with no terminal event yet; "settled" = closed by DrawAffirmed or DrawDisputed. Omit for both.

name: get_draws
